the thing with the steam machine
    you need to know what you are going into
        it is overpriced for the specs
        it is not going to run 4K/60
        turn the fps counter off, stop worrying about it
            if you care about numbers, don't get the Steam Machine
                simple as that
        it can locally play the less intense games just fine

overall
    it is a very well designed living room pc
    streaming from your main rig makes it a great supplemental piece of gear
    honestly very surprised by this
